meta.title: Request for Best Offer in Auction: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a non-Buyer and then as a Buyer on the same tenant to compare Request Best Offers authorization and execute the action under each role
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a non-Buyer and then as a Buyer on the same tenant to compare Request Best Offers authorization and execute the action under each role

steps.note: Open an existing event that is suitable for checking auction actions.

args.need: sign in as the non-Buyer user, verify Request Best Offers is refused or absent, then sign in as a Buyer and verify and execute Request Best Offers in the auction

steps.note: The catalog has no step for switching user roles or performing the same authorization check under two different users.
Assert that the final Buyer session sees Request Best Offers enabled in the auction Settings menu.
